description: This file defines the Resource class, which models the <resource> element in an entity configuration XML. It contains attributes for loader and location, and constructor logic to parse these attributes from an XML element, with validation.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: A final class modeling a <resource> element in entity configuration with loader and location attributes, constructed from an XML Element, with validation and accessor methods.

methods.name: Resource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Resource object from an XML Element, extracting and validating 'loader' and 'location' attributes.
